definitions.trigger: A required meeting place or arrival instruction is unconfirmed by its deadline
definitions.automatic: Request the missing fact; keep the readiness issue current
definitions.hostDecision: Confirm the location or an explicitly allowed alternative
definitions.resolution: Required location and instructions are confirmed

definitions.trigger: The chosen moving format lacks a confirmed route or joining points
definitions.automatic: Check required route facts and identify the specific gap
definitions.hostDecision: Confirm the route, permitted joining points and contingency
definitions.resolution: Route requirements are confirmed

definitions.trigger: The selected interaction, algorithm, programme or resource combination is unsupported or incomplete
definitions.automatic: Resolve capabilities and explain unsupported combinations
definitions.hostDecision: Confirm the run of show and supported operating model, or explicitly choose manual operation
definitions.resolution: Saved format passes capability validation

definitions.trigger: A committed guest source/import is incomplete, duplicated, stale or failed
definitions.automatic: Reconcile source batches without discarding successful rows; expose ambiguities
definitions.hostDecision: Resolve ambiguous identities or reconnect the source
definitions.resolution: Committed import and reconciliation finish with unresolved rows accounted for

definitions.trigger: A selected operation needs explicit guest information that is missing
definitions.automatic: Request only required fields and stop once supplied
definitions.hostDecision: Review an exception or approve host-assisted participation where allowed
definitions.resolution: Required information is present or operation uses an allowed fallback

definitions.trigger: A required resource count, capacity or allocation constraint is unconfirmed
definitions.automatic: Check capacity against the selected plan; identify shortages
definitions.hostDecision: Confirm resources or approve a viable reduced plan
definitions.resolution: Required resources and capacity are usable

definitions.trigger: A required responsibility has no accepted, authorized person for its scope
definitions.automatic: Request acceptance; track coverage and access separately
definitions.hostDecision: Assign or replace lead, check-in operator, pacer, sweep or marshal
definitions.resolution: Each required responsibility is accepted and executable

definitions.trigger: A selected automatic assistance policy cannot reach some intended guests
definitions.automatic: Resolve eligible endpoints and sender readiness; show coverage and alternatives
definitions.hostDecision: Choose an available route or handle unreachable guests
definitions.resolution: Delivery capability or explicit fallback covers the intended assistance

definitions.trigger: A join request, waitlist vacancy or expiring offer requires a decision
definitions.automatic: Order eligible candidates and prepare bounded offers where policy allows
definitions.hostDecision: Approve admission policy, exceptions or contested requests
definitions.resolution: Request/offer resolved or expired without overselling

definitions.trigger: A paid event has a confirmed payment-provider prerequisite
definitions.automatic: Read the provider-owned requirement and route to its owner
definitions.hostDecision: Complete provider setup
definitions.resolution: Authoritative provider prerequisite is resolved

definitions.trigger: Joining instructions are due or a guest newly becomes admitted
definitions.automatic: Publish current joining guidance and deliver through an eligible service route
definitions.hostDecision: Confirm unusual arrival instructions or channel fallback
definitions.resolution: Current instructions available and delivery evidence accounted for

definitions.trigger: An attendee claim is ambiguous or private runtime access fails
definitions.automatic: Offer verified recovery and retain the operational roster row
definitions.hostDecision: Confirm the intended identity; never auto-merge ambiguous people
definitions.resolution: Claim resolved or host-assisted path selected

definitions.trigger: A walk-in, waitlisted or cancelled guest requests entry
definitions.automatic: Check entitlement/capacity and prepare an admission decision
definitions.hostDecision: Approve an allowed exception or decline
definitions.resolution: Admission decision persisted independently of check-in

definitions.trigger: A guest arrives, a duplicate arrival is reported, or a mistake is identified
definitions.automatic: Apply absolute attendance idempotently; preserve party context; acknowledge duplicates
definitions.hostDecision: Verify arrival or correct the specific mistaken check-in
definitions.resolution: Desired attendance revision is confirmed

definitions.trigger: An admitted guest has not joined when departure/start is confirmed
definitions.automatic: Maintain current joining guidance; collect intentions; update affected guests; stop on join/decline/cutoff
definitions.hostDecision: Confirm physical departure, restricted late entry or an unreachable guest exception
definitions.resolution: Guest joins, declines, reaches cutoff or receives a recorded host disposition

definitions.trigger: A guest leaves, returns, sits out or opts out of a module
definitions.automatic: Stop affected future allocations/messages; prepare appropriate re-entry
definitions.hostDecision: Confirm departure/return where required and allowed recovery
definitions.resolution: Participation intent and affected future work agree

definitions.trigger: An admitted checked-in guest cannot use the selected activity
definitions.automatic: Explain the specific identity/profile/consent/assignment prerequisite
definitions.hostDecision: Resolve it or select an eligible host-assisted alternative
definitions.resolution: Guest can participate or an explicit allowed alternative is active

definitions.trigger: A guest is unassigned or a placement/group constraint changes
definitions.automatic: Prepare legal placements, swaps and future groups while preserving unaffected history
definitions.hostDecision: Approve disruptive changes, hard placement pins and publication
definitions.resolution: Approved valid assignment applied; affected guests informed

definitions.trigger: Someone reaches an assigned physical place
definitions.automatic: Keep assigned location separate from confirmed observed position
definitions.hostDecision: Confirm the guest is at that place
definitions.resolution: Observed placement is recorded for the current assignment

definitions.trigger: A table, court, station or piece of required equipment is unavailable
definitions.automatic: Suspend affected future reservations and prepare a repair
definitions.hostDecision: Close/reopen resource and approve redistribution
definitions.resolution: Capacity and assignments reflect the usable resources

definitions.trigger: A guest is waiting, repeatedly excluded or due the next opportunity
definitions.automatic: Track waiting/byes and propose the next eligible opportunity
definitions.hostDecision: Resolve incompatible constraints or an allowed fairness exception
definitions.resolution: Every waiting guest has a valid next opportunity or an explicit reason

definitions.trigger: A next round or reveal is due, cancelled or corrected
definitions.automatic: Prepare the next draft; validate constraints; preserve published history
definitions.hostDecision: Publish, cancel a pending reveal, or issue an explicit correction
definitions.resolution: Intended revision is published or cancelled; receipt visible

definitions.trigger: A court/group starts, finishes or needs a substitute independently
definitions.automatic: Update that unit's progress, release resources and prepare next use
definitions.hostDecision: Confirm actual start/finish and substitutions
definitions.resolution: Unit progress and resource occupancy agree

definitions.trigger: A round result is submitted, missing, corrected or disputed
definitions.automatic: Validate complete outcome data and recompute permitted standings
definitions.hostDecision: Record/correct the actual result and resolve disputes
definitions.resolution: Accepted result revision and derived standings agree

definitions.trigger: A step overruns, activity pauses, a cue is revisited or the remaining programme changes
definitions.automatic: Prepare revised timing and affected instructions without retracting past facts
definitions.hostDecision: Pause/resume, extend, skip or approve reordered remaining steps
definitions.resolution: Confirmed future programme and active clocks agree

definitions.trigger: A group is due to depart or the host confirms it has moved
definitions.automatic: Prepare headcount and destination; fan out consequences after confirmation
definitions.hostDecision: Confirm depart, wait or destination change per group
definitions.resolution: Departure revision and current destination recorded

definitions.trigger: A group reaches or misses an expected checkpoint
definitions.automatic: Request a scoped report; compare expected and accounted-for members
definitions.hostDecision: Pacer/sweep confirms headcount and unresolved dispositions
definitions.resolution: Checkpoint report current; discrepancies owned

definitions.trigger: A participant requests or requires a group change
definitions.automatic: Prepare transfer and notify responsible operators
definitions.hostDecision: Receiving group acknowledges handover where required
definitions.resolution: One accepted membership and responsible operator remain

definitions.trigger: A route or venue is blocked, unsuitable or changed
definitions.automatic: Identify affected groups and joining instructions; prepare approved alternatives
definitions.hostDecision: Confirm hold, diversion, return or replacement venue
definitions.resolution: New route/stop revision confirmed and affected guidance updated

definitions.trigger: A tracked leader position expires, permission ends or tracking stops
definitions.automatic: Remove live claims, fall back to confirmed guidance and request fresh information
definitions.hostDecision: Restart permitted sharing or provide a human progress report
definitions.resolution: Fresh location or explicitly labelled fallback available

definitions.trigger: A departed participant is unresolved at a checkpoint, transfer or finish
definitions.automatic: Reconcile against the relevant departure/participation episode; retain uncertainty
definitions.hostDecision: Responsible operator confirms returned, departed or assistance outcome
definitions.resolution: All required dispositions resolved or permitted completion exception recorded

definitions.trigger: A confirmed event change affects particular guests
definitions.automatic: Compute affected audience, update guidance and send bounded meaningful changes
definitions.hostDecision: Approve the underlying change; handle exceptional recipients
definitions.resolution: Current change is communicated or delivery exception owned

definitions.trigger: A delivery is rejected, unknown, expired or no longer relevant
definitions.automatic: Reconcile provider evidence; retry only when safe; cancel obsolete pending sends
definitions.hostDecision: Choose an allowed fallback for unresolved delivery
definitions.resolution: Delivery outcome known or explicit manual/unreachable disposition

definitions.trigger: A guest response creates an explicit unresolved request
definitions.automatic: Route a structured response to its workflow; assign genuine reply obligations
definitions.hostDecision: Answer or transfer an unhandled request
definitions.resolution: Request resolved or responsibility accepted

definitions.trigger: A guest asks for practical or introduction help
definitions.automatic: Acknowledge and route privately to an available responsible operator
definitions.hostDecision: Provide assistance and record the operational resolution
definitions.resolution: Request resolved, declined or explicitly transferred

definitions.trigger: A comfort or safety concern is explicitly reported
definitions.automatic: Route to authorized staff; constrain future allocations; retain a private unresolved case
definitions.hostDecision: Assess and act; decide separation, pause, removal or outside assistance
definitions.resolution: Authorized human records disposition; sensitive details stay restricted

definitions.trigger: An attendance action is queued offline or conflicts with a newer revision
definitions.automatic: Retry absolute operations; preserve applied results and mark data freshness
definitions.hostDecision: Resolve conflicting identity or attendance observations
definitions.resolution: Outbox synchronized or conflict explicitly resolved

definitions.trigger: Two operators act against the same changing resource
definitions.automatic: Reject stale intent; return new facts; preserve unrelated applied work
definitions.hostDecision: Reconfirm only when the proposed effect has materially changed
definitions.resolution: Action applied once against valid preconditions or abandoned

definitions.trigger: An action times out, a worker restarts or a device reconnects
definitions.automatic: Resume durable work and reconcile unknown effects before retrying
definitions.hostDecision: Handle genuinely unresolved external outcomes
definitions.resolution: Work reaches a known outcome with no blind duplicate effect

definitions.trigger: An action targets the wrong event/session or mode
definitions.automatic: Reject mismatched identity, scope or rehearsal/live destination
definitions.hostDecision: Open the intended event context
definitions.resolution: Only intended event/session receives the action

definitions.trigger: A host requests a change contrary to a suggestion or constraint
definitions.automatic: Explain whether the rule is a preference, overrideable operating rule or hard limit
definitions.hostDecision: Choose an allowed scoped override with reason and expiry
definitions.resolution: Explicit override applied or non-overridable limit retained

definitions.trigger: Event finishes, ends early or is aborted
definitions.automatic: Stop live tasks, identify unresolved obligations and prepare closure
definitions.hostDecision: Confirm finish/abort and allowed accountability exceptions
definitions.resolution: Live operation closed; surviving obligations handed to follow-up

definitions.trigger: Final attendance disagrees with confirmed observations or pending work
definitions.automatic: Assemble specific discrepancies without classifying silence as absence
definitions.hostDecision: Correct attendance and confirmed no-show dispositions
definitions.resolution: Final attendance reconciled with coverage stated

definitions.trigger: An authoritative provider reports a payment/refund discrepancy
definitions.automatic: Link provider reconciliation work and prevent duplicate financial effects
definitions.hostDecision: Resolve through payment owner; authorize money movement there
definitions.resolution: Provider-owned discrepancy resolved

definitions.trigger: A selected follow-up is due or becomes inappropriate
definitions.automatic: Prepare/deliver relevant messages through permitted routes; honor opt-outs and unresolved cases
definitions.hostDecision: Handle sensitive exceptions or explicitly authored content
definitions.resolution: Chosen follow-up delivered, skipped or exception owned

definitions.trigger: Event operations have closed with enough evidence for a recap
definitions.automatic: Summarize interventions, waiting, unresolved work and guest outcomes with denominators
definitions.hostDecision: Review lessons and choose changes for next time
definitions.resolution: Report represents available evidence and explicit unknowns
